প্রজ্ঞাপন
তারিখ, ১৭ আষাঢ়, ১৪২৪ বঙ্গাব্দ/০১ জুলাই, ২০১৭ খ্রিষ্টাব্দ

এস.আর.ও. নং- ২১৩-আইন/২০১৭/৫১/কাস্টমস।— Customs Act, 1969 (Act No. IV of 1969) এর section 19 এর sub-section (1) এবং মূল্য সংযোজন কর আইন, ১৯৯১ (১৯৯১ সনের ২২ নং আইন) এর ধারা ১৪ এর উপ-ধারা (১) এ প্রদত্ত ক্ষমতাবলে সরকার, জনস্বার্থে, জাতীয় রাজস্ব বোর্ডের সহিত পরামর্শক্রমে, এই বিভাগের ১৯ জ্যৈষ্ঠ, ১৪২৩ বঙ্গাব্দ মোতাবেক ২ জুন, ২০১৬ খ্রিষ্টাব্দ তারিখের প্রজ্ঞাপন এস.আর.ও. নং ১৪৮-আইন/২০১৬/১০/কাস্টমস এর নিম্নরূপ অধিকতর সংশোধন করিল, যথা:-

উপরিউক্ত প্রজ্ঞাপনের-

Customs Act 1969: Section 19(1) of this Act provides the legal authority for the Government to issue notifications regarding customs matters.
The Government exercises its power under this Act in consultation with the National Board of Revenue to amend previous customs notifications.
Value Added Tax Act 1991: Section 14(1) of this Act serves as a legal basis for the Government to issue notifications in the public interest concerning value added tax matters.
National Board of Revenue: The Government consults with this body as a mandatory procedural requirement before issuing or amending statutory notifications regarding customs and tax matters.
S.R.O. 148-AIN/2016: This specific statutory notification, originally issued in June 2016, is subject to further amendments through the current order.

H.S. Code: The entries corresponding to specific commodity codes in Table-1 are being replaced with new descriptive entries.
The amendments clarify the specific product descriptions for these codes when imported by registered textile yarn manufacturers.
TABLE-1: This table serves as the reference schedule for specific H.S. Codes and their corresponding product descriptions that are being amended by this order.
Manufacturer: The amendments specify that certain imported materials are subject to these classifications only when imported by VAT registered textile yarn manufacturers.

TABLE-2: This clause mandates specific amendments and insertions into Table-2 regarding the classification and duty treatment of various imported goods. These adjustments involve replacing existing descriptions, deleting specified entries, and inserting new H.S. Codes along with their corresponding descriptive and tax-related information.
H.S. Code: Several specific H.S. Codes have been updated, removed, or inserted into the tariff schedule to clarify the legal status and import conditions of the associated commodities. This ensures that the tariff structure remains aligned with the intended industrial uses and manufacturing support policies.
